nodes.label: Admin Module Authorization Gaps
nodes.rationale: Five admin routes lack authorize() entirely and userUpdateSchema admits role/password enabling privilege escalation plus plaintext password storage because no hash hooks exist.

nodes.label: Attendance Cron & Timezone Races
nodes.rationale: Find-then-insert cron races hit E11000, auto-checkout can stamp future times, and server-TZ setHours boundaries bleed an extra IST day into range queries.

nodes.label: Auth Session Lifecycle Flaws
nodes.rationale: Logout never deletes the Redis session, password change revokes nothing, sessions are not bound to the JWT subject, and sameSite:none cookies combine with reflect-all CORS.

nodes.label: Cache Invalidation Gaps
nodes.rationale: Recurring class: cached reads in account/user/calendar/session/notification paths lack invalidation in some writers, serving stale data up to TTL.

nodes.label: CORS/CSRF Credentialed Exposure
nodes.rationale: cors origin:true with credentials:true reflects any origin while cookies are sameSite:none in prod - any site can make credentialed cross-origin calls.

nodes.label: RBAC Read Action Bypass
nodes.rationale: authorize() returns next() unconditionally for action==='read', making read protection impossible by construction; root cause of admin PII exposure.

nodes.label: Saher Backend Project README
nodes.rationale: Stub containing only the heading 'Saher Backend'.

nodes.label: Dev Deploy CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted runner deploys on every push to main: git fetch + reset --hard origin/main in /home/saher/Test/saher-backend, then docker compose up -d --build backend, image prune, docker ps verification. Concurrency group cancels in-progress runs.

nodes.label: Worker Puppeteer Resource Leaks
nodes.rationale: PDF jobs never close Chromium pages (no try/finally), crash on empty result sets, and hard-limit queries at 1000 rows.

nodes.label: pnpm allowBuilds Native Build Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Permits postinstall builds for bcrypt, core-js, esbuild, msgpackr-extract, protobufjs, sharp.

nodes.label: Redocly Docs Config
nodes.rationale: Bundles/lints ./openapi/openapi.yaml with recommended ruleset; no-unused-components downgraded to warn.

nodes.label: Vulnerability Reporting Policy
nodes.rationale: Unfilled GitHub template - supported versions table commented out, reporting instructions generic.
